# Data Cleaning

## Load Packages


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(here)
library(nlme)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2) 
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(jtools)
library(haven)
library(modsem)
library(forecast)
library(gt)
```
:::


## Load Data

The merged baseline warmth SPSS dataset produced by the import pipeline (see the Baseline Warmth Import page) is read in from the project's computed-data folder. Import code is included but not rendered below.


::: {.cell}

:::



::: {.cell}

:::


## Transformation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#transform data wide to long
BL_WH_WidetoLong <- BL_WH %>%
  pivot_longer(
    #select columns like blmnwh.6, blmnwh.7, etc.
    cols = matches("^[^.]+\\.\\d+$"), 
    
    #split variable name based on period
    names_to = c(".value", "second"),  
    names_sep = "\\." ) %>%
  
  #convert second to numeric
  mutate(second = as.numeric(second))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#select four warmth variables, second, ID
BL_WH_Long <- BL_WH_WidetoLong %>%
  select(ID, second, blmnwh, blmpwh, blfnwh, blfpwh)

#set 0 as missing
BL_WH_Long$blmnwh[BL_WH_Long$blmnwh == 0] <- NA
BL_WH_Long$blmpwh[BL_WH_Long$blmpwh == 0] <- NA
BL_WH_Long$blfnwh[BL_WH_Long$blfnwh == 0] <- NA
BL_WH_Long$blfpwh[BL_WH_Long$blfpwh == 0] <- NA

#preview dataset
knitr::kable(head(BL_WH_Long, 5), caption = "Long Baseline Warmth Data")
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#create long format for negative interaction 
##(blmnwh = mom, blfnwh = partner)

BL_WH_Neg_Long <- BL_WH_Long %>%
  select(ID, second, blmnwh, blfnwh) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(blmnwh, blfnwh),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "blnwh") %>%
  mutate(
    personF = case_when(
      source == "blmnwh" ~ "mom",        #mom
      source == "blfnwh" ~ "partner" ),  #partner
    personN = case_when(
      source == "blmnwh" ~ 1,    #mom
      source == "blfnwh" ~ 2 ))  #partner 

#set personF as factor
BL_WH_Neg_Long$personF <- as.factor(BL_WH_Neg_Long$personF)

#set personN as factor
BL_WH_Neg_Long$personN <- as.numeric(BL_WH_Neg_Long$personN)

#preview dataset
knitr::kable(head(BL_WH_Neg_Long, 20), caption = "Long Baseline Warmth Negative Interaction Data")
```

These three long-format datasets (`BL_WH_Long`, `BL_WH_Pos_Long`, `BL_WH_Neg_Long`) are not re-exported here; the [Baseline Synchrony Calculation](Baseline-Synchrony_Calculation.qmd) page reads the same processed data from where it's already saved.

## Panel Plots

@fig-blnegative-warmth: Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true"}
fig_blnegative_warmth <- ggplot(data = BL_WH_Neg_Long, aes(second, blnwh, color = personF)) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("mom" = "#CC6677", "partner" = "#88CCEE"), name = "Person") +
  labs(title = "Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion",
       caption = "Smoothed trend of second-by-second negative-discussion warmth ratings by person (mom vs. partner), averaged across couples.") +
  xlab("Time") +
  ylab("Value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
fig_blnegative_warmth
ggsave("../../figures/baseline-warmth-synchrony/processing/fig-blnegative-warmth.png", plot = fig_blnegative_warmth, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Couple Warmth During Negative Discussion](Baseline-Synchrony_Processing_files/figure-html/fig-blnegative-warmth-1.png){#fig-blnegative-warmth width=672}
